title: scatterhist
summary: Create a scatter plot with marginal histograms.
description: `scatterhist(x,y)` creates a scatter plot with marginal distributions for vector inputs `x` and `y`. `scatterhist(x,y,Name,Value)` supports common MATLAB-compatible controls including `NBins`, `Group`, `PlotGroup`, `Kernel`, `Style`, `Bandwidth`, `Legend`, `Location`, `Direction`, `Color`, `Marker`, `MarkerSize`, `LineStyle`, `LineWidth`, and `Parent`. The return value is a three-element axes-handle vector for the scatter axes, x marginal axes, and y marginal axes.
notes: RunMat renders the chart using a 2-by-2 subplot grid. MATLAB's exact linked-axes geometry and UI container positioning are not modeled.
Default `NBins` values use Scott-rule estimates capped at 100 bins per marginal. Explicit `NBins` entries must be integers from 2 through 250.

The default `Location` is `southwest`, meaning the marginal histograms are below and left of the scatter axes. `Direction` controls whether marginal counts/densities extend toward (`in`) or away from (`out`) the scatter axes.

`Group` accepts numeric labels, character matrices, string arrays, cell labels, or categorical labels and renders one scatter/marginal series per group. Legends default on for grouped charts unless `Legend` is set to `off`, and grouped histograms default to stair outlines unless `Style` is set explicitly.

`Color`, `Marker`, `MarkerSize`, `LineStyle`, `LineWidth`, and `Bandwidth` accept scalar/single-value forms or cyclic per-group forms such as color-character sequences, string/cell style arrays, numeric vectors, and RGB or bandwidth matrices.
`Kernel` set to `on` renders Gaussian kernel-density marginal lines using Scott bandwidth estimates or `Bandwidth`. `Kernel` set to `overlay` renders both binned counts and kernel lines.
`Style` supports `bar` and `stairs`. Use `Kernel` to select kernel-density marginal lines or count/kernel overlays. `PlotGroup` set to `off` pools grouped observations for plotting.
